bull_case: Rubin은 Blackwell 대비 최대 10배 낮은 토큰 비용을 목표로 하고, 9월 MLPerf에서 2.5~3.7배 처리량 향상을 보였다. Blackwell이 이미 출하 대부분과 $89B 분기 데이터센터 매출을 차지해 기술 개선이 파일럿을 넘어 수익으로 전환됐다. 네트워킹·소프트웨어 확장은 새 가치풀을 연다.
bear_case: Rubin의 비용곡선 우위가 독립 생산 TCO로 검증되지 않았고, financed AI-cloud deployment가 채택 속도를 부풀릴 수 있다. $36B AI-cloud agreements와 $108.5B maximum gross guarantees의 지원 대상 매출 비중이 높다면 관측된 S-curve 일부는 자생 수요가 아닐 수 있다.
thesis: GPU·CPU·NVLink·네트워킹·소프트웨어 공동설계는 AI 비용곡선을 재편하고, Q2 Data Center $89.0B(+117%)와 Blackwell 과반 출하는 채택이 주류 수익으로 전환됐음을 보여준다. 그러나 채택의 자생성에는 더 큰 공백이 확인됐다. Q2 filing은 $36B AI-cloud agreements와 $108.5B maximum gross guarantees를 공시한다. 이는 기술적 채택을 부정하지 않지만 financed deployment 비중을 분리하지 못하게 한다. 독립 TCO·소프트웨어 매출·지원 대상 매출 비중이 없어 90점대 확신은 배제하고 기존 78.75를 유지한다.

evidence.claim: NVIDIA's January 5, 2026 Rubin announcement targets up to a 10x reduction in inference token cost and 4x fewer GPUs to train mixture-of-experts models versus Blackwell.
In MLPerf Inference v6.1 preview results published September 16, Rubin NVL72 delivered up to 3.7x GB300 NVL72 throughput on Qwen3-VL and up to 2.5x on DeepSeek-R1.
Q2 FY27 Data Center revenue was $89,023M, up 117% year over year and 18% sequentially; Blackwell accounted for the majority of system shipments.
Q2 FY27 gross margin was 75.0%, up from 72.4% a year earlier, with the increase attributed to improved Blackwell Ultra mix.
The platform spans accelerated compute, NVLink and Ethernet networking, AI software and open models; Spectrum-X Ethernet revenue grew 2.6x year over year in the Q2 FY27 earnings call.
NVIDIA disclosed $366B of future commitments and said some AI-cloud and model-maker customers lack long-term infrastructure contracts and investment-grade financing capacity.

counterevidence: Rubin's 10x token-cost claim is vendor-provided and workload-specific; the September MLPerf preview shows 2.5x to 3.7x throughput on the cited models rather than a universal 10x outcome.
Major customers such as hyperscalers can fund custom accelerators and are not constrained incumbent vendors, limiting NVIDIA's ability to monopolize the value chain.
Customer land, power and financing constraints have led NVIDIA to provide guarantees and investments, so reported adoption may partly reflect vendor-supported capacity creation.
China data-center market foreclosure and broader AI regulation can prevent technical advantage from converting into addressable revenue.
unknowns: Rubin과 leading custom ASIC의 comparable production TCO per token.
NVIDIA recurring AI software revenue·gross margin의 독립 공시.
$36B AI-cloud agreements·$108.5B 보증 대상 고객의 Data Center 매출 비중.

uncertainties.rationale: The platform-level improvement is benchmarked, but the largest 10x claims remain vendor-specific and workload-dependent.
Revenue and shipment adoption are strong, while customer financing support makes the durability of marginal demand uncertain.
Networking and software are real adjacent pools, but hyperscalers can deploy internally funded custom silicon and cap platform control.

falsifiers: If independent production benchmarks show Rubin cost per token within 20% of leading custom ASICs at comparable latency and utilization, the cost-performance disruption thesis weakens materially.
If Data Center revenue declines year over year for two consecutive quarters while customer guarantees and investment commitments rise, adoption is no longer self-sustaining.
If networking and software fail to produce separately observable revenue growth or standards adoption within two years, the multiple-adjacency thesis is falsified.

key_kpis.threshold: at least 2x advantage versus comparable custom ASICs

subscores.rationale: 10x token-cost targets and 2.5~3.7x MLPerf throughput show a structural rather than incremental shift, placing the result above the 75 anchor. Vendor-specific workloads and incomplete independent TCO evidence exclude 90.

Data Center $89.0B, +117%, Blackwell 과반 출하와 Rubin production shipments는 주류 확산을 지지한다. 반면 $36B AI-cloud agreements와 $108.5B maximum gross guarantees 때문에 채택 중 financed deployment 비중을 분리할 수 없어 90을 배제한다. 관측된 매출·마진이 이미 대규모여서 기존 85를 유지한다.

Networking and AI software/open-model infrastructure provide two adjacent value pools, matching the observable 70 row. Hyperscalers are capital-unconstrained customers building custom silicon, so the rubric modifier caps this criterion at 70.
